dedupe_keys.name: splmodel process based soil plant livestock coupled model for grassland ecosystems

description: A process-based model that couples soil, grassland plants and grazing livestock. The DataCite record says it represents plant functional groups and livestock grazing, digestion and the return of manure and urine, and simulates vegetation dynamics, livestock production, soil carbon, nitrogen and water cycling and greenhouse gas balances under different climate conditions and grazing management scenarios. The record was published on 20 May 2026 by Junyi Liang and Dianjie Wang as free downloadable code under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Coverage is grassland ecosystems in general; the study sites are not stated on the page read. Caveats: the programming language, file contents and calibration data are not stated on the page read, and there is no accompanying documentation link in the metadata. For simulation it can estimate how drought or heat changes forage and livestock output on grazing land, one input to food supply and rural economy models. A related catalogue record is the GRAZPLAN family of pasture models, listed in review because its host was unreachable.
